entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Maui 10 preview6] When starting up the app crashes: System.ArgumentException: 'We only support xmlns aggregation in ... #31101
  • InvalidCastException in MkMapView on iOS #31098
  • Maui Essentials MAPT M02:2024 – INSECURE FILE PROVIDER PATH SETTING #31097
  • Changing IsGrouped on runtime with CollectionViewHandler2 does not properly work #31096

PullRequests

Created

  • [iOS] Changing IsGrouped on runtime with CollectionViewHandler2 does not properly work - fix #31100
    platform/ios, community ✨, collectionview-cv2
  • [housekeeping] Automated PR to fix formatting errors on main #31095
    t/housekeeping ♻︎, area-infrastructure
  • [housekeeping] Automated PR to fix formatting errors on inflight/current #31094
    t/housekeeping ♻︎, area-infrastructure
  • [housekeeping] Automated PR to fix formatting errors on net10.0 #31093
    t/housekeeping ♻︎, area-infrastructure
  • [iOS] ToolbarItem scolor with custom BarTextColor - fix #31092
    platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-toolbar

Updated

  • Improve iOS Label performance #30864
    community ✨, area-controls-label, perf/general, .NET 9 SR11
  • Make IsActivated property public in Window.cs #30987
    community ✨, area-controls-window, .NET 10.0-rc1
  • Refactor Essentials interfaces to inherit from base ISensor and IDeviceCapability interfaces #31086
    area-essentials, .NET 10.0-rc1

    platform/windows, community ✨, area-controls-dialogalert

    platform/android, platform/ios, area-controls-shell, community ✨
  • [Android] Improve Keyboard Accessibility: Support Spacebar for Android Gesture recognisers #29649
    platform/android, area-gestures, t/a11y, .NET 9 SR11
  • [iOS] Flyout Items Not Displayed in RightToLeft FlowDirection in Landscape - fix #26762
    area-controls-flyoutpage, community ✨, .NET 9 SR11
  • [iOS] ScrollView content offset shifts unexpectedly when FlowDirection is changed #30053
    platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-scrollview, .NET 9 SR11
  • Add IsRefreshEnabled Property and Platform-Consistent IsEnabled Semantics to RefreshView #30692
    p/0, .NET 10.0-rc1
